CONTRACT OF EMPLOYMENT

This Contract is made on 2 January 2026 between Northwind Logistics Private Limited ("the Employer") and Priya Raman ("the Employee").

1. DUTIES
The Employee shall work as a Dispatch Coordinator and shall follow the reasonable instructions of the Employer.

2. DELIVERY DEADLINES
The Employee must pay a penalty of INR 50,000 for any delay in dispatch. The penalty will apply regardless of the reason for the delay. The Employer may also terminate the employment at any time without notice.

3. SALARY
The Employee shall be paid INR 42,000 per month on the last working day of each month.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY
The Employee shall not disclose customer lists or pricing to anyone outside the Employer during or after employment.
